Gallery settings

Badge meanings

Same full label set: neighbor labels exactly match the query labels.

Partial label match: at least one label overlaps, but the full set differs.

Label unavailable: no usable prepared GlycoMotif subtype label was available for that neighbor.

Different prepared labels: both glycans have labels, but none overlap.

Top-neighbor overlap

Each row compares two models using the same query glycans. Mean shared top neighbors is the average number of accessions shared between the two top-25 neighbor lists. Mean normalized overlap is the shared count divided by the total unique accessions across both lists. Zero means no overlap; one means the two models returned the same neighbors.
